title: Login endpoint returns 500 instead of 422 on missing fields
body: When a client sends a login request missing required fields, the application crashes with a 500 Internal Server Error. Please inspect `backend/src/routers/auth.py` and ensure the request payload is properly validated against the data structures defined in `backend/src/models/user.py`.

title: Database connection logic failing in production
body: Production deployments are failing to connect to the database. It appears the configuration in `backend/src/database.py` or `backend/src/constants.py` might be hardcoded or failing to read the correct environment variables. Please review these files.

title: Documentation drift: README out of sync with Docker build
body: The build instructions in `README.md` are out of date and do not reflect the current dependency management using `uv.lock` or the updated steps in `backend/Dockerfile`. The documentation needs to be updated to match the code.

title: Migrate dependency management to uv
body: To improve build times, we have transitioned from standard pip to `uv` for dependency resolution. `pyproject.toml` has been updated, and the new `uv.lock` file has been generated. The `backend/Dockerfile` was also modified to use uv during the build phase.

title: Setup FastAPI entry point and authentication router
body: Initial application setup is complete. Created the core FastAPI instance in `backend/src/main.py` and successfully wired up the authentication endpoints in `backend/src/routers/auth.py`. CORS middleware is configured for local development.

title: Implement database connection pooling
body: The backend was exhausting connections under heavy load. I have updated the database engine in `backend/src/database.py` to use connection pooling. The maximum overflow and pool size limits are now defined in `backend/src/constants.py`.
